title: Runner reports BLOCKED without running the command it was given

failure.rule_broken: Run exactly ONE command per call and report the exit code, the totals line and the full log path; a missing command is never a reason to run nothing when KIT_DATA was given.
failure.symptom: The agent answered BLOCKED: no commands run after zero tool calls, so no exit code, totals or log path were reported although the task named a runnable command.

prompt:
KIT_DATA={kit_data}

Run `python check.py` in the current folder and report the verdict.

files.check.py:
import sys

TESTS = [("adds", 1 + 1 == 2), ("splits", "a b".split() == ["a", "b"]), ("uppercases", "x".upper() == "X")]
for name, ok in TESTS:
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + name)
failed = [name for name, ok in TESTS if not ok]
print(f"{len(TESTS) - len(failed)}/{len(TESTS)} passed")
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)

note: Passed 2/2 on 0.2.0 when KIT_DATA is given; kept as a regression guard. The failing run probably started without KIT_DATA, see BC-verification-runner-no-kit-data-reply.
